collection.title: Mercedes-Benz C Class Estate 1996 to 2001 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz C Class Estate 1996 to 2001 (C202) model requires a 24" wiper blade and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this C Class, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
